summary: Accepted (#4822, PR #4836, hosted run 39942183045, fdev acceptance 2026-10-23) on public SDD.Cli 2.4.0, original FS.GG.UI.Template 0.32.3 (Rendering descriptor at Templates 24f3c307) and the Workspace.Template 0.19.3 fs-gg-project-knowledge overlay, for app and game profiles. Provider typed: fsgg-sdd scaffold --provider rendering --param lifecycle=typed-sdd records typed-sdd and creates the canonical store and capture guide but no knowledge CI, because the original Rendering payload carries none. The caller must compose dotnet new fs-gg-project-knowledge --lifecycle typed-sdd --output . without --force; it adds exactly .github/workflows/project-knowledge.yml and scripts/check-project-knowledge.py. With an owner-authored knowledge workflow present it refuses with exit 73 and changes nothing. Provider-only typed creation therefore leaves no knowledge CI; the gap is filed as a Templates follow-up. Raw typed: dotnet new fs-gg-ui --lifecycle typed-sdd creates no .fsgg/ or .config/ and no knowledge. The caller adds the overlay, then a local tool manifest under .config/ pinning SDD 2.4.0 (`dotnet new tool-manifest --output .config`; newer SDKs otherwise write it at the root). Until knowledge is initialized, the checker refuses with 'Missing .fsgg/knowledge-guide.md'. Explicit knowledge initialize is idempotent. The result is standalone knowledge readiness, not a Typed SDD workspace: lifecycle-scaffolding-pending.md remains. Omitted lifecycle gives the sdd lane on both routes: the descriptor default for provider, the packed template default for raw. There is no store and no knowledge CI, and the overlay emits nothing without --lifecycle or with --lifecycle sdd. Provider sdd rows still contain .fsgg/knowledge-guide.md, which SDD init seeds for every lifecycle; the guide alone does not make a project knowledge-ready. The effective lane is readable from the created product's lifecycle-scaffolding-pending.md heading: '# Typed SDD lifecycle scaffolding pending' or '# Lifecycle scaffolding pending (sdd lane)'. A flag or packed default is not evidence of it. Typed rows pass the full knowledge contract and the 10,485,760-byte checker boundary while preserving product bytes. Limits: one Linux host; Coord stays at 0.94.0; the run has no retry, and a transient dotnet tool restore hang can fail it.
title: External Rendering raw and provider routes to project knowledge
